ICAP::method
Description
The ICAP::method command returns the ICAP request method. This will
either be “REQMOD” or “RESPMOD”
Syntax
ICAP
::
method
ICAP::method
Gets the ICAP request method
Examples
when
ICAP_REQUEST
{
ICAP
::
method
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ICAP_REQUEST
